title: Fern Ridge Clinic Newsletter | Fall 2026
summary: Orchid Health is the leading rural health provider in Oregon. Named as one of the best places to work in 2021, they specialize in whole-person care, patient relationships, and innovation in rural care. They were named the 2020 Rural Health Hero of the year due in part to their efforts in the communities they serve.
body_markdown:
# **Good Food, Live Music & Great Neighbors**


HR Service teammember Bob, helping grill things up!


More than 100 community members joined our Fern Ridge BBQ in September for food, live music from the Etherton Project, and fun on the inflatable slide. Raffle prizes included a child’s bike, Bluetooth speaker, air purifier, and grilling accessories.


Local band Etherton Project


Thank you to Gentle Dental, Veneta Downtown Farmers Market, Mid Lane Cares, and everyone who helped make the gathering possible. We loved catching up with familiar faces and meeting new neighbors. Spending time together outside the clinic helps us build the relationships that make local care personal.


# **Support Between Visits**


Living with two or more ongoing conditions, such as diabetes, arthritis, or high blood pressure? If you’ve seen a provider within the past 12 months, ask about our Chronic Care Management (CCM) program.


Your provider and care team spend extra time reviewing your needs, helping you manage medications, and coordinating care to support your health goals between visits.


Patients with any insurance type, including Medicare, OHP, and commercial plans, may qualify at no cost to you. Call 541-234-3255 to learn more.


# **Community Events & Holiday Support**


2025 Treelight festival


Orchid employees enjoying a ride on their float!


- **Produce Plus:** Free produce at our clinic every fourth Wednesday, 1–4 PM. On **November 25** , we’re adding stuffing and other Thanksgiving staples, to help fill your table on the holiday.
- **Thanksgiving Dinner:** **November 25** at Mid Lane Cares’ Fern Ridge Service Center. The Love Project food pantry also offers food support. Call **541-935-4555** for dinner details and holiday meal box information.
- **Veneta Light Parade:** **December 10, 7 PM.** Look for your Orchid team—we’ll be there!
- **S.A.N.T.A. Toy Giveaway:** **Saturday, December 12, 9 AM–3 PM** , Veneta Elementary School gym. Bring proof of Fern Ridge residency and each child’s age.


# **Thank You, Jeanna!**


RN Jeanna Nicoson is on to her next adventure.


As registered nurse Jeanna Nicoson prepares to leave Orchid Health, we’re grateful for the care and connection she brought to our clinic. Jeanna’s approach centers on the whole person—helping patients understand their care and take an active role in their health.


She’ll especially miss the patients and families she has come to know along the way. Jeanna says,


> ***“It has been my absolute privilege to teach, provide guidance, and support my patients as you worked toward—and achieved—your health and wellness goals. Watching your progress over the years has truly been one of the highlights of my career. I also loved getting out and connecting with so many of you at our community events. Thank you all for three unforgettable years of trust, growth, and connection... I wish you all continued health, happiness and wellness!”***


Thank you, Jeanna, for being part of our clinic and community. We wish you the best in what comes next!


### **From Our Patients**


> "The staff here truly listens. I never feel rushed, and I feel like apartner in my own healthcare. Fern Ridge is lucky to have this clinic!"
